description: Steel profile data catalog, structural calculation engine, and parameter form. Implements the complete geometry form with wizard/expert modes, steel profile database (IPE, RHS/SHS, Z-profiles, square tubes), load calculations (snow/wind zones), and profile selection algorithms.
steps: Create src/data/profiles.ts with complete steel profile catalog as typed JSON objects: IPE profiles (80-600) with W_pl, I, A, mass, h, b, tw, tf; RHS/SHS profiles (60x60x3 to 200x200x8) with A, I, W_pl, mass, dimensions; Z profiles (Z140-Z300) with properties; Square tubes for truss chords (80x80x4 to 150x150x6) with properties

Create src/data/loads.ts with snow zone values (zones 1-5: 0.7, 0.9, 1.2, 1.6, 2.0 kN/m2), wind zone values (zones 1-3: 0.3, 0.45, 0.55 kN/m2), and covering self-weight (sheet: 0.15, sandwich: 0.25 kN/m2)

Create src/utils/geometry.ts with column spacing algorithm: base spacing 5m, n = round(L/5), actual spacing = L/n. Also purlin spacing calculation (~2-2.5m), roof height from angle, ridge height calculation.

Create src/utils/calculations.ts with profile selection algorithms: (a) Side columns IPE - wind load per column = q_wind * spacing, M = q*h^2/2, W_pl_required = M/f_y, select smallest IPE where W_pl >= required; (b) Rafter IPE (span<=18m) - q = (snow+self_weight)*frame_spacing, M_max = q*L^2/8, select IPE; (c) Truss (span>18m) - height = L/12, N = M_max/h_truss, select square tube where A >= N/f_y; (d) Z-purlins - load = (snow+covering)*purlin_spacing, select Z profile; (e) Bracing - light/standard/heavy based on total loads

Create src/types/index.ts with TypeScript interfaces: HallParameters (span, length, wallHeight, roofAngle, steelGrade, snowZone, windZone, coveringType), CalculationResults (sideColumnProfile, endColumnProfile, rafterProfile or trussProfile, purlinProfile, bracingDiameter, columnSpacing, purlinSpacing, trussHeight), SteelProfile interface
Create src/hooks/useHallCalculations.ts - custom hook that takes HallParameters and returns CalculationResults using useMemo, calling all calculation functions

Create src/components/FormPanel.tsx with full parameter form: wizard mode (step-by-step: 1-Geometry, 2-Loads, 3-Steel grade) and expert mode (all sections visible). Include inputs for: span (10-30m slider+input), length (20-100m), wall height (4-10m), roof angle (5-25 degrees), steel grade (S235/S355 radio), snow zone (1-5 select), wind zone (1-3 select), covering type (sheet/sandwich radio)
Create src/components/ResultsPanel.tsx showing calculated profile selections - displays chosen profiles for each element with key properties (name, mass, W_pl)
Add all form labels and result labels to i18n translation files (PL + EN)
Style form with dark industrial theme: dark inputs with orange focus rings, section dividers, step indicators for wizard mode, toggle button for wizard/expert mode switch
acceptance_criteria: Profile catalog contains all specified profiles with correct properties (W_pl, I, A, mass, dimensions)
Changing span from 15m to 20m (crossing 18m threshold) switches from rafter IPE to truss calculation
Column spacing for L=48m correctly calculates n=10, spacing=4.8m
Form validates ranges (span 10-30, length 20-100, height 4-10, angle 5-25)
Wizard mode shows steps sequentially, expert mode shows all at once
Results panel updates immediately when parameters change
All text is translated in both PL and EN
pnpm build completes without TypeScript errors
